title: Plugins
offline: This computer is not connected. Reconnect to continue.

actionFailed: The action did not complete. Check your connection and retry.
noPlugins: No plugins are installed on this computer.
noComputer: Connect a computer to use its installed plugins.
listUnavailable: Some plugin lists are unavailable. Previously loaded content is retained.
taskHint: Describe what you need in a task. Cindy will use the appropriate plugin. Existing tasks keep their model and permissions.

noTasks: No tasks on this computer yet
taskSettingsHint: Applies to tasks created by this plugin from now on. Existing tasks keep their model and permissions.

autoPermissionHint: Automatic approval lets Cindy assess permission requests automatically. Use it for future plugin tasks?
settingsReload: Reload settings to check whether the action was saved
modelsUnavailable: The computer’s model catalog is unavailable. Check the connection and retry.
identityChangedHint: Configuration stopped because this computer’s authorization identity changed. Verify the computer and register its device identity again before connecting. This card cannot replace a registered identity.
computerAuthorizationHint: This sign-in method uses a callback on the computer. Complete it using this card’s computer entry, then return to check its status.
authorizationCheckHint: Check this setup step’s status. Unconfirmed actions are not automatically replayed.
nativeSetupHint: Complete the configuration below on your phone. Account connections that require a computer-local callback can continue through the computer entry.
chooseComputerFolder: Choose a folder on your computer
folderReadFailed: Could not read this folder. Check the connection or choose another folder.
automationDraftHint: Confirm the content, timing and model, then save to create this automation.
automationInvalid: Check the name, content and schedule.

previewFailed: Could not load the preview. Check the computer connection and web service.
simulatorOnComputer: This computer hosts the simulator. Open the computer screen to view and control it.
